jobs.occupation: JP Dynasty ApS søger en Group Kitchen Manager
jobs.description:
JP Dynasty ApS er en asiatisk restaurantgruppe med base i København og driver flere brands og restauranter.

I takt med at koncernen fortsætter med at vokse, søger vi en erfaren Group Kitchen Manager / køkkenchef med ansvar for flere restauranter, som kan sikre en ensartet og effektiv køkkendrift på tværs af vores lokationer.

Primære arbejdsopgaver

• 
Overordnet ansvar for den daglige køkkendrift på tværs af flere restauranter

• 
Regelmæssige besøg og kontrol af køkkenerne for at sikre ensartet kvalitet, hastighed, hygiejne og driftsstandard

• 
Udarbejde, forbedre og implementere SOP'er og standardiserede arbejdsprocedurer

• 
Lede, træne og støtte Kitchen Managers og køkkenteams

• 
Sikre overholdelse af fødevaresikkerhed, hygiejne og HACCP

• 
Kontrollere vareforbrug, lønomkostninger, madspild og køkkeneffektivitet

• 
Overvåge lager, varebestilling, lageroptælling, FIFO og råvareforbrug

• 
Anvende lager- og managementsystemer til at identificere driftsmæssige og økonomiske problemer

• 
Koordinere tæt med centralkøkken, indkøb, restaurantchefer og administration

• 
Ansvar for implementering af nye retter fra test og standardisering til lancering i restauranterne

• 
Tilpasse produktion, forberedelse og bemanding efter omsætning og driftsbehov

• 
Håndtere akutte driftsproblemer og udvikle langsigtede løsninger

• 
Deltage i åbning af nye restauranter, herunder køkkenopsætning, arbejdsprocesser og medarbejdertræning

• 
Rapportere regelmæssigt til ledelsen om køkkendrift, problemer og forbedringstiltag

Vi forventer, at du

• 
Kan kinesisk og engelsk flydende, både mundtligt og skriftligt

• 
Har erfaring med køkkenledelse fra en restaurantkæde, flere restauranter eller centralkøkken

• 
Har erfaring med ledelse af Kitchen Managers, kokke og køkkenmedarbejdere

• 
Kan tage selvstændigt ansvar for flere restauranter og ikke kun ét køkken

• 
Har solidt kendskab til fødevaresikkerhed, køkkenhygiejne og HACCP

• 
Har erfaring med kontrol af food cost, lager, madspild og løneffektivitet

• 
Kan anvende Microsoft Office, Google Workspace eller tilsvarende kontorsoftware

• 
Kan arbejde med lagerstyrings-, indkøbs- eller restaurantmanagementsystemer

• 
Har god talforståelse og kan identificere problemer gennem rapporter og data

• 
Har erfaring med at udarbejde og implementere SOP'er

• 
Har stærke ledelses-, kommunikations- og træningsevner

• 
Kan håndtere flere driftsmæssige udfordringer samtidigt i et travlt miljø

• 
Er ansvarlig, proaktiv og løsningsorienteret

• 
Kan arbejde i weekender og har fleksible arbejdstider efter restaurantdriftens behov

Det er en fordel, hvis du har

• 
Erfaring fra asiatiske restauranter, japansk eller kinesisk køkken eller fast-casual-kæder

• 
Erfaring fra centralkøkken eller fødevareproduktion

• 
Erfaring med åbning af nye restauranter

• 
Erfaring med menuudvikling og standardisering af produkter

• 
Erfaring fra en restaurantgruppe med flere brands

• 
Kendskab til danske regler om fødevaresikkerhed og restaurationsdrift

• 
Tidligere erfaring fra restaurationsbranchen i Danmark

Vi tilbyder

• 
En central lederstilling i en voksende asiatisk restaurantgruppe i København

• 
Ansvar på tværs af flere brands og restauranter

• 
Stor indflydelse på den daglige drift og gode udviklingsmuligheder

• 
Mulighed for at deltage i nye restaurantåbninger, produktudvikling og udvikling af centralkøkken

• 
Løn efter erfaring og kvalifikationer

Arbejdssted: København, med regelmæssigt arbejde på tværs af vores restauranter
Virksomhed: JP Dynasty ApS
Stilling: Group Kitchen Manager / Køkkenchef med ansvar for flere restauranter
Ansættelse: Fuldtid

JP Dynasty ApS is Hiring: Group Kitchen Manager

JP Dynasty ApS is a Copenhagen-based Asian restaurant group operating multiple brands and locations.

As our group continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced Group Kitchen Manager / Multi-Unit Kitchen Manager to oversee kitchen operations across several locations.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Oversee daily kitchen operations across multiple restaurant locations

• 
Conduct regular kitchen inspections to ensure consistent food quality, speed, hygiene, and operational standards

• 
Develop, improve, and implement kitchen SOPs

• 
Manage, train, and support Kitchen Managers and kitchen teams

• 
Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, and HACCP requirements

• 
Monitor and control food costs, labour costs, waste, and kitchen efficiency

• 
Supervise inventory, ordering, stock counts, FIFO, and raw material usage

• 
Use inventory and management systems to identify operational and cost issues

• 
Coordinate closely with central kitchen, purchasing, restaurant managers, and the office team

• 
Manage implementation of new dishes from testing and standardisation to launch across all locations

• 
Adjust production levels, preparation, and staffing based on sales and operational needs

• 
Handle urgent operational issues and develop long-term solutions

• 
Support new restaurant openings, including kitchen setup, workflows, and staff training

• 
Provide regular reports to management on kitchen performance, issues, and improvement plans

Requirements

• 
Fluent Chinese and English, both spoken and written

• 
Previous experience managing kitchens in a restaurant chain, multi-unit restaurant group, or central kitchen operation

• 
Experience managing Kitchen Managers, chefs, and kitchen teams

• 
Ability to manage several locations independently, rather than only one kitchen

• 
Strong knowledge of food safety, kitchen hygiene, and HACCP

• 
Experience with food cost control, inventory management, waste reduction, and labour efficiency

• 
Comfortable using Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar office software

• 
Able to use inventory, purchasing, or restaurant management software

• 
Strong analytical skills and ability to identify operational problems through reports and data

• 
Experience creating and implementing SOPs

• 
Strong leadership, communication, and staff-training skills

• 
Able to handle multiple operational issues in a fast-paced environment

• 
Responsible, proactive, and highly execution-focused

• 
Able to work weekends and maintain a flexible schedule according to operational needs

Preferred Qualifications

• 
Experience in Asian restaurants, Japanese cuisine, Chinese cuisine, or fast-casual restaurant chains

• 
Central kitchen or food production experience

• 
New restaurant opening experience

• 
Menu development and product standardisation experience

• 
Experience working in a multi-brand restaurant group

• 
Knowledge of Danish food safety and restaurant regulations

• 
Previous restaurant industry experience in Denmark

We Offer

• 
A key management position in a growing Asian restaurant group in Copenhagen

• 
Responsibility across multiple brands and restaurant locations

• 
Significant operational responsibility and development opportunities

• 
Opportunity to participate in new restaurant openings, product development, and central kitchen development

• 
Salary based on experience and qualifications

Location: Copenhagen, with regular travel between our restaurant locations
Company: JP Dynasty ApS
Position: Group Kitchen Manager / Multi-Unit Kitchen Manager
Employment: Full-time

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the immersion of the elements. In total, 79 standard (220m long, 9m high, 45m wide) and 10 special elements (38m long, 12,5m high, 50m wide) will connect the Femern Belt Tunnel to both Germany and Denmark.

To be able to float up, transport and immerse the Tunnel Elements, the elements require temporary installations. These installations ensure that the elements float, stay balanced, immerse and can connect to the preceding element. A team of mechanics and electricians will install and test these installations.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Execute the TE systems works whilst coordinating closely and effectively with the involved (internal) stakeholders to optimize efficiency.

Plan, execute and register maintenance & repairs to the TE systems equipment:

o Pumps / Piping / Valves

o Electrical components

o Subsea sensors

o Hydraulic cylinders / Powerpacks / manifolds

o Umbilical winches / Sliprings

o Rolling equipment

Thereby ensuring operational equipment in compliance with legislative-, safety- and user requirements.

You will lead the team of technicians installing, maintaining and repairing the Tunnel Elements systems during the preparation, transport and installation phase of Tunnel Elements. Understand the functionality of the Tunnel Element systems. Troubleshoot system during installation and operation. Maintain and organize the work area (workshop and yard facilities) to ensure an orderly and safe workplace in compliance with Danish regulation, company procedures, and good work practice. Set up, select and support the TE systems team of technicians to ensure effective and reliable production cycle.

In the role of the Mechanical Supervisor, there will be interface with subcontractors, Operational departments of various disciplines and operations staff.

Qualifications:

The TE systems Mechanical Supervisor:

- Has the ability to read and understand technical drawings, working methods and working procedures.

- Plans the work ahead.

- Manages daily interface with other TE outfitting parties.

- Communicates in English (minimum B2 level) both written and spoken.

- Optimizes the usage of the TE systems team capabilities.

- Supports and coaches the TE systems technicians.

- Has excellent interpersonal skills

- Organizes daily toolbox / pre-start meetings.

- Connects the tasks to the bigger picture.

- Provides support and input on risk assessments for TE mobilization / demobilization, general tasks.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company. 

FLC offers attractive employment conditions on a Danish contract according to The Danish Salaried Employees Act (Funktionærloven). Pension health insurance and lunch arrangement will be available. 

Workplace:

Rødbyhavn Denmark

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

Contact:

For questions related to the position, please contact tri@flc-jv.com, lge@flc-jv.com

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The FLC Survey Department plays a key role in supporting the construction of this immersed tunnel project. The marine survey team delivers positioning, navigation, monitoring, and hydrographic survey services for offshore construction activities using advanced technologies such as multibeam echo sounders, Inertial Navigation systems, LBL and USBL systems, Fibre Optic Gyroscopes and many more. Together with over 60 hydrographic and topographic survey professionals from more than 15 countries, the department ensures accurate survey data for all project phases. The topographic survey teams support construction through stake-out, control, and as-built surveys, utilizing state-of-the-art equipment including Total Stations, GNSS, drones, laser scanners, and specialist software for planning, execution, and data processing.

Within the marine survey team, the Positioning Specialists play a key role in the immersion of tunnel elements. They install, configure and operate advanced positioning systems, combining GNSS, INS, LBL, tautwire, and distance sensor technologies to ensure the precise placement of tunnel elements.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Prepare positioning systems for (re-)installation operations by performing maintenance, calibration, and configuration of the hard- and software.

Configure positioning software in preparation for positioning operations, such as Qinsy, Delph SP and Delph INS and project specific software.

Operate and monitor the positioning systems during tunnel element installation operations, such as GNSS (Septentrio), INS (Exail), LBL (Exail), SVP (AML) and a project specific Light Tautwire and Distance Sensor system.

Remote or on-board troubleshooting of positioning system issues.

Analyse positioning data of tunnel installation process.

Write installation-, configuration- and commissioning reports for positioning systems.

Create reports for ‘as-installed’ and ‘as-configured’ survey set-ups.

Create ‘as-installed’ reports for installed tunnel elements

Cooperate with the operational team to schedule installation and removal of survey systems.

Cooperate with pontoon and vessel crews during remote- or on-board troubleshooting.

Concise communication with the immersion master during installation of the tunnel elements.

Qualifications:

Degree, diploma, or equivalent professional experience in Hydrographic Surveying, Geomatics or Geodesy, Survey Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Marine Technology, Navigation, Positioning, or a related technical discipline

Minimum 5 years of experience with surface and/or subsea positioning systems.

Proven experience configuring, maintaining, and operating marine positioning systems during offshore operations.

Experience with working with Qinsy survey software.

Experience with USBL and/or LBL positioning systems.

Ability to configure, calibrate, and troubleshoot complex positioning systems.

Strong capability in quality control, analysis, and interpretation of positioning data.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Able to remain calm and make sound decisions during critical offshore operations.

Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly when coordinating with immersion masters, vessel crews, engineers, and survey teams.

Conditions:

jobs.occupation: Experienced Thai Cook for BanThai Restaurant
jobs.description:
Experienced Thai Cook for BanThai Restaurant

About the position

BanThai Restaurant & TakeAway ApS in Ringsted is looking for an experienced and motivated cook with solid knowledge of authentic Thai and Asian cuisine.

You will become part of our kitchen team and work closely with the kitchen management and other employees to ensure efficient daily operations, consistent quality and a high standard of food preparation.

The position is full-time and includes both preparation and cooking duties. We are looking for a reliable and professional employee who can work independently, cooperate with colleagues and contribute positively to the development of our kitchen.

Main responsibilities

Your duties will include, among other things:

• 
Preparing ingredients for daily kitchen operations, including washing, cutting, portioning and correct storage.

• 
Preparing and cooking authentic Thai and Asian dishes according to the restaurant’s recipes and quality standards.

• 
Ensuring consistent taste, quality, portion sizes and presentation.

• 
Maintaining a clean, organised and efficient kitchen station.

• 
Assisting with daily preparation and service in both smaller and larger kitchen operations.

• 
Following instructions from kitchen management regarding production, preparation and daily priorities.

• 
Monitoring stock levels and informing management when ingredients need to be ordered.

• 
Receiving, checking and correctly storing food deliveries.

• 
Ensuring proper labelling, date marking, storage and rotation of ingredients.

• 
Following all hygiene, HACCP, food safety and workplace safety procedures.

• 
Cleaning kitchen equipment, utensils and work areas.

• 
Cooperating with the kitchen team to ensure efficient and smooth service.

• 
Assisting with other naturally occurring kitchen duties when required.

The list of duties is not exhaustive, and tasks may vary depending on the restaurant’s operational needs. Opgaverne er baseret på arbejdsbeskrivelsen i den tidligere kontrakt.

Qualifications

We expect that you:

• 
Have documented professional experience as a cook.

• 
Have strong experience with Thai cuisine and other Asian cooking traditions.

• 
Understand traditional Thai ingredients, preparation methods, flavours and presentation.

• 
Have experience working in a professional restaurant kitchen.

• 
Can work independently and as part of a team.

• 
Can maintain quality and overview during busy service periods.

• 
Have good knowledge of food hygiene and safe food handling.

• 
Are reliable, flexible and responsible.

• 
Are willing to work mornings, evenings, weekends and public holidays when scheduled.

• 
Can communicate in Thai and English.

• 
Danish language skills are an advantage but not a requirement.

Relevant culinary education, certificates and documented work experience will be considered an advantage.

Employment conditions

• 
Full-time employment.

• 
Average working time: 37 hours per week, excluding breaks.

• 
Working hours are primarily scheduled from Tuesday to Sunday between 9:00 a.m. and 10:00 p.m.

• 
Shifts may vary depending on operational needs and will generally be scheduled as morning or evening shifts.

• 
Fixed monthly salary: DKK 37,500 before tax.

• 
Annual fixed salary: DKK 450,000 before tax.

• 
Holiday entitlement and holiday pay are provided in accordance with Danish legislation.

• 
Workplace: BanThai Restaurant & TakeAway ApS, Nørretorvet 22, 4100 Ringsted.

• 
Expected starting date: by agreement and subject to any required Danish residence and work permit.

• 
The employment is planned as a fixed-term position with the possibility of extension.

About BanThai

BanThai is a Thai restaurant and takeaway in Ringsted focusing on authentic Thai food, traditional preparation methods and dishes inspired by different regions of Thailand.

Our goal is to create genuine Thai food experiences based on quality ingredients, professional preparation and a strong respect for Thai food culture.

We offer a professional and multicultural working environment with a strong focus on cooperation, quality, responsibility and development.

• 
The opportunity to learn from and work closely with our Head Chef, Chef Nie, winner of Thai Iron Chef.

• 
Professional development through hands-on training in authentic Thai cuisine, traditional techniques and kitchen operations.

Application

Please send:

• 
CV

• 
Short application

• 
Copies of relevant education or culinary certificates

• 
Documentation of previous employment and professional experience

• 
References, where available

Applications should be sent to:

job@banthai.dk

Please write “Application – Experienced Thai Cook” in the subject line.

BanThai Restaurant & TakeAway ApS
Nørretorvet 22
4100 Ringsted

Do you want to contribute to protecting energy systems of the future and secure OT infrastructure in Renewable Energy? Then apply to become part of an international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry. PEAK Wind is looking for a Cyber Security Consultant, who wants to take their cyber security career to the next level and is looking to work on a diverse and exciting portfolio within wind power and other renewable Energy sources.

Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable Assets
At PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of Renewable Energy assets and take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and independent power producers among our clients.

Job Content, Responsibilities, and Possibilities:
Based in one of our offices in Denmark (Aarhus and Copenhagen), or Germany (Hamburg) you will be working in a team supporting customer projects and programs within the field of IT/OT and cyber security. We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative working environment. SCADA and Cyber Security is a crucial area for our clients, who we support on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across disciplines, ensuring seamless integration, operation, and cyber security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- Leading risk assessments of IT/OT environments for clients across large-scale renewable assets, and providing risk mitigation strategies and recommendations.
- Developing IT/OT operating models, guidelines, and procedures for renewable assets.
- Developing and communicating IT/OT infrastructure designs to our customers.
- Implementing cyber security solutions for IT and OT environments on large-scale renewable assets, and reporting to project management, customers directly, and/or other senior engineering functions.
- Adapt to legislation and regulatory requirements for the IT/OT environment. Advise on the utilisation of best practices, policies, and standards, such as IEC62443, and ISO27000.
- Build strong relationships with stakeholders, in PEAK Wind and among our customers.

What you Bring and your Qualities
We expect that you have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience from a similar position, and previous experience with cyber security functions, such as Risk Management, Vulnerability Assessments, and Security Assessments. Furthermore, experience within security systems including firewalls and security engineering is required. Recognized security certification is desirable and experience with implementation of national standards such as NERC/CIP or NIS2 would be considered an advantage. The ideal candidate would have experience with renewable energy projects and/or implementation of Cyber Security Management Systems in other industries.

As a person, you are a team player, and you thrive working in an international and diverse team with mixed cultures and seniorities. You are detail-oriented and possess strong problem-solving skills in IT/OT systems. As PEAK Wind is a global company, you must also have strong English communication skills, both oral and written. Finally, we are looking for a candidate with excellent stakeholder management skills.

Experience the Highest Degree of Involvement
PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.

Interested and want to know more?
If you have any questions or want to know more about the position, please contact People & Development via recruitment@peak-wind.com (recruitment@peak-wind.com) . We look forward to receiving your applications & CVs as soon as possible. Please apply through ‘Apply’ at the bottom of the page. Applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis.

PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

PEAK Wind is looking for a Senior SCADA Consultant who can be an integrated part of our SCADA and Cyber Security team, ensuring best-in-class deliverables for our clients, and building a bridge between technical, commercial, and operational OT and SCADA assets.

We take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and Independent Power Producers among our clients.

Solution-driven Senior SCADA Consultant with Technical Network Know-how
Based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, or Zaragoza you will be supporting clients in all aspects of the project lifecycle, from early development to operation.

We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative way of working. SCADA and Cyber Security is a key area for our clients and receives increased attention on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across different disciplines ensuring seamless integration, operation, and Cyber Security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- Drafting and reviewing requirements suppliers and service providers of OT systems, SCADA, and Cyber Security for renewable assets, mainly within onshore and offshore wind
- Negotiating SCADA and Cyber Security requirements in various supply and service contracts on behalf of our clients
- Designing basic network archtiecture and identifying functional requirements from network designes
- Supporting operational teams on OT, SCADA, and Cyber Security investigations and improvements
- Identifying and integrating technical upgrades, new systems, and functionalities
- Managing sub-suppliers for performance management, defining maintenance, and optimizing the reliability

Experienced SCADA Consultant with a holistic mindset:
We are looking for a candidate with knowledge within OT/SCADA systems and Cyber Security. You have broad experience working with SCADA, critical OT or IT systems, across the array of different systems used in production environments. Furthermore, you are familiar and used to working with security standards such as ISO270xx, IEC62443, NERC-CIP, or similar. Knowledge of industrial computer networks is an advantage but not a requirement.

Irrespective of your background, you are solution-oriented and like to find smarter and more efficient ways to solve problems. You are motivated by solving problems and finding solutions that work in the real world and not just on paper. Preferably you have experience in project management or experience from a Supervisor position, which has given you commercial awareness and the ability to work independently. The ideal candidate is self-driven, proactive, and has a solution-oriented attitude. You are a good communicator with a proven ability to build sound business relationships and represent them in project meetings and presentations. As PEAK Wind is an international company, you need to have good English communication skills.

Experience the Highest Degree of Involvement
PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities!

Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly.    

 Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

We are in close collaboration with all Airbus design offices worldwide. 

 We are working together with two other off-shore teams, in a follow the sun approach : 
 one based in Mobile (USA) 
 one based in Bangalore (India)

The company
The ILL is an international research facility at the forefront of neutron science and technology. Its High-Flux Nuclear Reactor delivers the world's most intense neutron beams to a suite of over 40 scientific instruments. Every year, some 1800 international researchers visit the ILL to carry out cutting-edge experiments across a range of scientific disciplines, driving innovation in the fields of health, energy, the environment and quantum materials. The ILL is also involved in the production of radioisotopes for medical applications. The ILL employs over 500 staff from 25 different countries, in a diversity of careers and a multicultural and inclusive environment.

The Science Division at ILL brings together close to 200 scientists, engineers, and technicians who work collaboratively to provide users with advanced experimental capabilities and expert scientific support. The DS is responsible by operating world-class neutron scattering instruments, supporting an international user community, conducting cutting-edge research, and developing new experimental techniques. In addition, the division drives the development of next-generation instrumentation and computational tools, fosters international collaborations, and contributes to advanced training.

About the position
As an experiment support and instrument technician, you will be responsible for the operation and development of experimental equipment and for providing support for experiments conducted at the ILL.
You will work closely with the scientists in charge of the instruments you will be assigned to. You will also collaborate with the other technicians in the Spectroscopy group. You will act as technical contact for the instrument WASP within this group. Depending on the needs of the different groups, you may be asked to work in parallel on other instruments within the Spectroscopy group.

Your tasks
Your main duties will involve the following:
-    Performing maintenance work and repairs on instruments and their ancillary equipment
-    Assisting in-house and visiting scientists with the preparation of their experiments
-    Designing new equipment in collaboration with ILL scientists and technical support groups
-    Improving the instruments and the way in which experiments are conducted by devising innovative technical solutions
-    Performing precision machining of simple mechanical parts (lathing, milling, drilling) at short notice
-    Installing, maintaining and operating sample environment equipment (cryostats, furnaces, etc.)
-    Organising the purchase of new equipment and spare parts

Desired profile
-    You have a Level 4/5 qualification (e.g. NVQ, BTEC HNC/HND or equivalent) in mechanical, maintenance or electronic engineering.
-    You have experience in the assembly and alignment of precision mechanical assemblies.
-    You have knowledge of CAD software.
-    Experience in scientific instrumentation, in particular in the field of cryogenics, would be an advantage.
-    You must have a sound knowledge of English and be willing to learn French (a language course will be paid for by the ILL).

Benefits
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

jobs.occupation: Industrial Liaison Scientist to Grenoble France
jobs.description:
Context
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.
Within the Industrial Liaison Unit (ILU, 2 people) of ILL's Applied Science Group (18 people), you will act as an effective and efficient interface between industry and the cutting-edge neutron techniques and scientists available at the ILL for proprietary research and development (R&D) as well as non-destructive testing (NDT).

Your tasks
In this context, you will:
. Organise and perform efficient and successful proprietary R&D and NDT utilising ILL's neutron instruments, working closely with instrument scientists and industry clients.
. Build up expertise in neutron techniques and operating instruments relevant to industrial R&D and NDT opportunities.
. Contribute to a strategy to increase industrial R&D and NDT activity at ILL, to maximise revenue from this activity (currently around 0.5 M? per year).
. Undertake outreach and communication activities for industrial R&D/NDT at ILL to build up a portfolio of high-potential industry contacts and generate new business opportunities.
. Manage the customer base and maintain an accurate record of all industry-related activities at ILL for periodic reporting and review for optimisation of ILL's industry strategy with Management.
. With support from the legal service at ILL, organise the contractual agreements for proprietary beam time.
. With ILL's Grants Office, your line manager and relevant ILL scientists, identify and pursue project-based opportunities for industry-related research at ILL.
. Liaise with local, regional and international partners to nurture a robust, collective approach to industry services at large-scale research facilities.

Your profile
. You hold a PhD in engineering or a natural science (or equivalent qualification) and have several years of experience in a range of analytical techniques, preferably using neutrons.
. You have excellent communication skills, are highly interested in applied research and have some experience in working with industry / R&D / NDT.
. You have a strong project management culture, which will enable you to plan and manage the ILL's involvement in R&D and NDT with industry partners.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a stable 5-year fixed-term contract position in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions
